_note: P12.1 cut rules (plan-cinematic section 2) as numbers, read by Sim/Cine/Lint/CutLint. Times in real seconds, angles in degrees, heights in meters. Flash, brightness and shake caps are checked once per list by Sim/Cine/Reveals/StageLint, reached through CutLint.Run.

minSeconds.why: No shot under 1 s except a whip pan.

averageExemptKinds.source: plan-cinematic section 2 conflict: a chapter (4 to 6 s, 3+ shots) averages 2 s a shot at most; a two shot stinger (2 to 4 s) averages 2 s at most and a one shot stinger can be under 2.5 s
averageExemptKinds.why: Scene kinds that skip the average shot length check, because their length and shot count rules force an average under the floor.

sceneSeconds._note: backdrop loops and has no length rule, so it is not listed.

fullMin.why: A full scene has 3 shots or more.

stingerMin.why: A stinger has 1 shot or more.

stingerMax.why: A stinger has 2 shots or fewer.

afterCutSeconds.why: No caption starts this soon after a cut.

sampleHz.why: Poses are sampled 30 times a second inside each shot.

tenseMaxRoll.why: Up to 3 degrees of roll in a mood marked tense.

tenseMoodIds.source: Data/cine/moods.json and plan-cinematic section 3 event map
tenseMoodIds.why: Real mood ids that may roll up to tenseMaxRoll: the rival, courtroom, bust and broke moods.

maxYawRate.why: Camera yaw speed cap in degrees a second.

maxPitchRate.why: Camera pitch speed cap in degrees a second.

maxFovRate.why: Field of view change cap in degrees a second.

maxWhipPans.why: One whip pan a scene at most.

shakeMoodIds.source: plan-cinematic section 2 and the section 3 event map (bust uses bust_cold, broke uses bleak_gray)
shakeMoodIds.why: The only moods that may shake. Checked in wave 2.

maxFlashes.why: Full screen flashes a scene. Checked in wave 2.

maxBrightnessJump.why: Largest brightness jump inside the window below. Checked in wave 2.

brightnessWindowSeconds.why: A third of a second. Checked in wave 2.

minMeters.why: The camera never goes under 0.3 m above the ground.

groundY.source: starting guess, owner to tune by feel
groundY.why: Ground height on the plain district stage.

minDegrees.why: Two shots in a row on one subject differ by 30 degrees or more.

neutralDegrees.why: A shot within 10 degrees of the line is neutral and may reset the side.

nearMeters.source: N167 Line180 definition shared with the director (r38)
nearMeters.why: A subject whose center is this close to the segment between the two people (a midpoint, a prop between them) is held to the line too. A wide of a building 30 m away stays exempt.

toleranceSeconds.why: One thirtieth of a second (0.0333...) rounded up at the sixth decimal so a cut placed exactly one frame from actionAt passes and anything later fails.

aspect.source: the value hard coded in Cine.Build.cs and Cine.Stinger.cs before N212 (2.39:1 scope)
aspect.why: Letterbox bar aspect ratio for the full list and the stinger (2.39:1 scope).
